title: How to hire an AI specialist and brief them well
seoTitle: How to hire an AI specialist and brief it well
description: Hire an AI specialist from AI Blocks: pick a role or named agent, add it to your AI, write a clear brief, set safe access levels and check the first jobs.
lede: An AI specialist gives your own AI a job description, a method and checks for one kind of work. This guide shows how to choose one from AI Blocks, add it to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, write a brief it can act on and keep live actions under your control.
